title: feat(nmot2x2): O two-tick composition on #7214: reverse UNDEFINED, face UNDEFINED, composition fails
science: O at tau0=t vs tau1=t+1 on the #7214 x-probes; O(A,B,C at t) empty, filled at t+1, so composition=fail.
